controls.note: Trusted integration layer implementation is future work.
Determinism checks reject hand-edited logical content.

boundaries.description: Git repository, refs, working tree, generated contract artifacts.

threats.description: Agent or external actor advances main without gates.
threats.name: Unauthorized ref advance

threats.description: Editing a generated file to fake compliance.
threats.name: Hand-edited generated artifact

threats.description: Rewriting existing history to hide provenance.
threats.name: History rewrite

boundaries.trust_boundary: Only the trusted integration layer may advance refs; ordinary credentials cannot.

controls.note: Path policy engine is a Phase 2 deliverable.

boundaries.description: Windows path normalization, traversal, junction/symlink/reparse attacks.

threats.description: Junction or symlink redirection escapes allowed roots.
threats.name: Path traversal / reparse escape

threats.description: 8.3 or case-insensitive aliases bypass policy.
threats.name: Case/short-name alias confusion

boundaries.trust_boundary: Path policy rejects traversal, reparse escape, alias confusion before any access.

threats.description: VFP source/data content must never become shell commands.
threats.name: Injection through project content

threats.description: Inherited secrets reaching helper processes.
threats.name: Env secret leakage to helpers

boundaries.trust_boundary: Explicit allowlist, argument arrays, minimal env, isolated workspace.

controls.note: Canonical GREENFIELD dependency lock resolved exactly once from the approved PyPI origin (authorization OPERATOR-GREENFIELD-PYPI-B0-2026-10-08) and frozen before candidate-tree sealing; automated origin/integrity tamper rejection and lock-update automation remain future work.

boundaries.description: Package-index and repository origins for every dependency.

threats.description: Dependency installed from an unapproved index.
threats.name: Unapproved origin / shadow package

threats.description: Re-resolving after the candidate tree is sealed.
threats.name: Floating re-resolution

boundaries.trust_boundary: Approved origins only; exact artifact hashes; no floating re-resolution after sealing.

controls.note: No VFP assets exist in this repository; scan-based control.

boundaries.description: Operator-provided VFP9 SP2 runtime, COM automation, interactive sessions.

threats.description: Vendoring licensed Microsoft assets into public artifacts.
threats.name: Proprietary asset redistribution

threats.description: Executing analyzed project code outside an isolated workspace.
threats.name: Application source execution

boundaries.trust_boundary: Operator-provided assets only; never vendored; trusted-profile execution only.

boundaries.description: DBF/FPT/CDX binary parsing, Memo handling, original-value exposure.

threats.description: Private values appearing in logs, evidence, or MCP responses.
threats.name: Memo/original-value leakage

threats.description: Malformed binaries crashing or confusing the engine.
threats.name: Corrupt/malicious DBF input

boundaries.trust_boundary: dbfbridge public API only; original values never leak into logs/evidence/prompts.

controls.note: Bounded connection management is Phase 13 deliverable.

boundaries.description: Shadow/migration target database, credentials, cross-engine parity.

threats.description: PostgreSQL secrets in config/evidence/logs.
threats.name: Credential exposure

threats.description: Migration writing outside controlled staging.
threats.name: Unbounded writes to target

boundaries.trust_boundary: Explicit target references; bounded connections; no implicit prod writes.

controls.note: Truthful capability state enforced by design and tests.

boundaries.description: MCP protocol transport (stdio/HTTP), tool/resource schemas, client trust.

threats.description: Simulating unfinished features as success.
threats.name: Placeholder success for missing capability

threats.description: Project-controlled content altering protocol structure.
threats.name: Injection via tool arguments/data

boundaries.trust_boundary: Thin adapter over Core; unavailable capabilities reported truthfully.

threats.description: Old PASS evidence reused after bound inputs changed.
threats.name: Stale evidence reuse

threats.description: Original DBF values or secrets entering evidence.
threats.name: Sensitive data in evidence

boundaries.trust_boundary: Evidence is freshness-bound to exact commit/tree/SOT/lock identities; sensitive classes redacted.

controls.note: OS write-protection boundary is AUTONOMOUS-path work.

boundaries.description: Coding-agent/controller boundary, model routing, write protection.

threats.description: Authoring agent counting its own review as independent.
threats.name: Builder self-approval

threats.description: Model-authored process editing the frozen contract.
threats.name: SOT mutation by model identity

boundaries.trust_boundary: Builder never self-approves; controller pinned by commit/tree; SOT write-protected for model-authored runs.

boundaries.description: Remote refs, PRs, CI checks, releases, package publication.

threats.description: Remote mutation without authorization.
threats.name: Unauthorized push/publication

threats.description: Release artifacts without a qualified-release record.
threats.name: Publishing unqualified content

boundaries.trust_boundary: Explicit operator authorization bound to invocation hash and destination identity; local qualification stays available.

methodology: STRIDE-style structured boundaries; statuses DECLARED/PLANNED only
notes: Mitigations are never marked PASS merely because they are declared; PASS requires executed deterministic evidence.
